svg.text: POLICY INFORMATION POINTS — signals that feed the trust algorithm
Entra Conditional Access + ID Protection risk · Cisco
Front Door + WAF · API Management (JWT, scopes)
AVD gateway · Defender for Cloud Apps · PAM broker
NAC switches · hospital NGFW · Azure Firewall Premium
Purview DLP · Key Vault Managed HSM · Private Link
Implicit trust zone kept as small as possible
private endpoints only · micro-segmented workloads · no lateral path between
Data plane: subjects reach resources only through a PEP; the PE re-evaluates identity, device, location, data sensitivity and threat signals on every session (NIST SP 800-207 tenets 3–6).
